notes: *out* of *Bring my soul out of prison* stays with the verb and `מִן` takes only *of*. Rule 44 governs directly: where the direction a particle states is also written in the clause by a preposition, the particle restates what the Hebrew has written and is part of the English phrasal verb, which is the contract's own `הָלַךְ` with `מִן` → *went away from him*. The unit's note names the competing reading `מִן` → *out of* headed on *out* under rule 24; its appeal to word order is the weaker ground, since *out of* does stand contiguous here — what decides it is that bare *Bring* does not write the hiphil's whole lexeme.

`בִּי` is `unrepresented` under rule 40, the ASV promoting its object to the direct object of *compass* while *about* is the English phrasal verb's particle joining `יַכְתִּרוּ` under rule 44; the suffix takes the written *me*.
`אֶת` before `שְׁמֶךָ` takes the *unto* by which *give thanks* reaches its object — rule 16's first family, where the preposition exists only to attach the object to the English verb.
The marginal *Or, crown themselves because of me* was read and set aside; the printed *shall compass me about* governs, rule 38.
`תִגְמֹל` → *thou wilt deal bountifully* heads on *bountifully* under rule 44, *deal* alone dealing anything; the competing head *deal* is named in that unit's note.
